name: Fin AI Agent
short_description: Outcome-priced AI agent that resolves support conversations across chat, email, voice and messaging.
notes: Fin works standalone on other helpdesks (Salesforce, HubSpot, Freshworks) with no seat fee. 14-day trial with unlimited outcomes. Intercom seat prices from intercom.com/pricing; billing cadence not stated. Lead Scoring mapped from qualification/disqualification outcomes.

name: Zendesk AI Agents
short_description: AI agents built into Zendesk that autonomously resolve tickets, billed per automated resolution.
notes: Monthly-billed seat prices shown (annual: $19/$55/$115). Includes 5 (Team) or 10 (Professional) automated resolutions per agent/month. 14-day trial. Capabilities from general knowledge of pricing page only; Ticket Triage/Email not re-verified on product page.

name: Sierra
short_description: Enterprise conversational AI agents for customer service across chat, voice, email, SMS and WhatsApp.
notes: No public pricing page (sierra.ai/pricing 404). Site states outcome-based pricing. Translation mapped from 'built-in multilingual support'.

name: Decagon
short_description: Enterprise AI agents for chat, email and voice support driven by natural-language procedures (AOPs).
notes: No public pricing; demo required.

name: Ada
short_description: Enterprise AI customer service agent across voice, messaging and email that takes actions in business systems.
notes: Pricing page reached; no public prices, demo for custom quote. 'Ada Computer' uses API, code and MCP tools; open APIs and SDKs.

name: Forethought
short_description: Agentic AI suite (Solve, Triage, Assist, Discover) that resolves, routes and classifies support tickets.
notes: Tiers published without prices. Solve API and analytics API on Enterprise tier; AI article creation (Discover) mapped to Content Writing.

name: Agentforce Service
short_description: Salesforce's autonomous agents for service and sales, billed per conversation, credits or user add-on.
notes: Agentforce 1 Editions 'from $550 user/month'. Foundations is a no-cost tier for experimentation (requires Salesforce). Voice actions cost 30 credits. Billing cadence (annual contracts typical) not stated.

name: Gorgias AI Agent
short_description: E-commerce AI agent trained on your Shopify catalog that resolves support tickets and helps convert shoppers.
notes: Pricing page reachable but price tables are client-rendered and could not be extracted; page states 'AI Agent on every plan, pay only when it resolves a conversation' and helpdesk priced by ticket volume (50-5,000/mo), not per agent. Third-party blogs list prices but were not used.

name: Freddy AI Agent
short_description: Freshdesk's AI agent that autonomously resolves customer queries, billed per session bundle.
notes: Seat prices are billed annually (monthly-billed price not shown). First 500 Freddy AI Agent sessions included on all plans. 14-day Enterprise trial. Ticket Triage not explicitly verified on pricing page.

name: HubSpot Customer Agent
short_description: Service Hub AI agent that answers customer questions and resolves tickets, powered by HubSpot Credits.
notes: Page showed Starter $7 monthly vs $20 annual (inverted; likely promo or extraction error — verify). Professional $90 monthly/$100 annual, $1,500 onboarding; Enterprise from $150/seat, $3,500 onboarding. Customer Agent requires Pro/Enterprise seat; 14-day unlimited free access to Customer Agent.

name: Lyro AI Agent
short_description: Conversational AI agent for SMB websites that answers customer questions from your knowledge base.
notes: Starter/Growth figures shown as '/mo' with annual $290.04/$590.04 — the $24.17/$49.17 are likely annual-equivalent monthly prices. Plus is 'starting at $300/mo + usage'. Premium guarantees 50% Lyro resolution rate. 7-day trial, no card.

name: Chatbase
short_description: No-code builder for AI support agents trained on your data, deployable on web, voice and helpdesks.
notes: Monthly prices; 20% off annual. API access from Standard. MCP not mentioned.

name: Siena AI
short_description: Agentic AI for e-commerce customer experience that automates support tickets across channels.
notes: Custom quote form but platform fee and per-ticket price are published. Social Media Management mapped from social-tools integration; verify.

name: Maven AGI
short_description: Enterprise AI agents for text and voice support plus agent-assist inside Zendesk and Salesforce.
notes: No public pricing; demo required. 'Intelligent Fields' mapped to Data Extraction.

name: Lorikeet
short_description: Outcome-priced AI support concierge for fintech and healthtech across chat, email, voice, SMS and WhatsApp.
notes: Plans billed annually. Scale tier: $0.90 chat / $1.20 voice resolutions, $0.27 triage. 30-day free trial mentioned on homepage.

name: Parloa
short_description: Enterprise AI agent platform for voice-first customer service, inbound and outbound.
notes: No public pricing; demo and value calculator only. Translation mapped from 'Expanded Language Coverage'.

name: Yellow.ai
short_description: Agentic AI platform for customer service across chat, voice and email on 35+ channels.
notes: Free plan: 1 agent, 500 chat sessions/month, then $0.99 per resolution. Basic and Enterprise prices not published.

name: Help Scout AI Answers
short_description: Help Scout's AI agent that auto-resolves customer questions from your docs, charged per resolution.
notes: Seat prices monthly (16% off annually). AI Answers includes 3-month free trial with unlimited resolutions. 15-day trial for Standard/Plus.

name: Botpress
short_description: Platform for building and deploying LLM-powered AI agents for support across web, messaging and voice.
notes: Plus/Team prices are billed annually (monthly is ~20% more; not shown). AI spend credits included ($25/$150). Voice only on Enterprise. GitHub repo exists for community contributions; full-platform open-source status unclear.

name: Crisp AI Agent
short_description: All-in-one support inbox with an AI agent that automates customer conversations, priced per workspace.
notes: AI credits included ($5/$25/$75 ~ 90/450/1,350 automated conversations). 14-day trial. MCP server listed on Plus plan. Billing cadence of listed prices not stated.

name: GitHub Copilot
short_description: AI pair programmer with agent mode, cloud coding agent and code review across IDEs, CLI and GitHub.
notes: Pro/Pro+/Max include $15/$70/$200 AI credit allowances. Plans page as fetched showed Business/Enterprise as contact-sales (historically public per-seat prices; re-check). MCP on all plans.

name: Claude Code
short_description: Agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands and opens PRs from terminal, IDE or web.
notes: Monthly-billed prices (Pro $17, Team $20/$100 annual). Max 'starting at $100'. Enterprise $20/seat/month + usage at API rates, annual. Free Claude plan excludes Claude Code. Also usable with Anthropic Console API key and Agent SDK. Not open source.

name: OpenAI Codex
short_description: OpenAI's coding agent for cloud, desktop, IDE and an open-source terminal CLI, included in ChatGPT plans.
notes: Pro 'from $100' ($100/$200/$500 tiers). Business $25 monthly or $20 annual. API usage billed at API token rates. Codex CLI is Apache-2.0; cloud agent proprietary.

name: Cursor
short_description: AI code editor with autonomous agents, cloud agents and Bugbot automated PR review.
notes: Individual has Pro/Pro+/Ultra tiers; only the $20 entry price was extractable. On-demand usage billed in arrears; Bugbot usage-based for individuals. Browser Automation from Enterprise 'browser controls'; verify.

name: Devin
short_description: Autonomous AI software engineer (now including Windsurf) that plans, codes and ships in the cloud.
notes: windsurf.com/pricing now redirects to devin.ai/pricing (Windsurf merged into Devin plans). ACU pricing no longer shown. Capabilities from general product knowledge beyond pricing page; verify Test Generation/Code Review.

name: Replit Agent
short_description: Cloud IDE agent that builds, deploys and hosts full apps from natural-language prompts.
notes: Monthly-billed prices ($18/$90 annual). Core includes $20 model credit; Pro $100 credit and 10 parallel agents. Free tier not shown on fetched page.

name: Lovable
short_description: AI app builder that generates and deploys full-stack web apps from chat prompts.
notes: lovable.dev/pricing not extractable; prices from Lovable's own docs. Pro/Business scale with credit tiers up to 10,000 credits ($2,250 / $4,300 per month).

name: Bolt
short_description: Browser-based AI agent that builds, runs and deploys full-stack web apps from prompts.
notes: Monthly billing; up to 28% off yearly. Free: 1M tokens/month. SEO boosting and AI image editing listed on Pro (Image Generation mapped from image editing; verify).

name: v0
short_description: Vercel's AI agent that generates, iterates on and deploys web apps and UIs.
notes: Plus shown as $30 (reduced from $90). Plans include monthly credits; model token rates listed separately.

name: Jules
short_description: Google's asynchronous coding agent that works on GitHub repos in a cloud VM and opens pull requests.
notes: Tiers by task limits (15/100/300 daily). Pro/Ultra come with Google AI Pro/Ultra subscriptions; USD prices not extractable from Google One page. REST API and Jules Tools CLI documented.

name: Kiro
short_description: AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE and CLI that turns prompts into specs, code and tests.
notes: Free: 50 credits. Paid: 1,000/2,000/5,000/10,000 credits. Capabilities (tests) from general knowledge; MCP not mentioned on pricing page.

name: Augment Code
short_description: Coding agent with a codebase Context Engine, CLI and AI code review for GitHub PRs.
notes: Plans include equal $ usage (LLM, context, compute), flat rate up to 50 seats, pay-as-you-go top-ups. No free tier shown.

name: Factory Droids
short_description: Agent-native development platform whose 'Droids' run coding tasks locally or in the cloud.
notes: factory.ai redirects to factory.com. SDK available; Code Review not confirmed on pricing page.

name: CodeRabbit
short_description: AI code review agent that comments on pull requests with line-by-line feedback and fixes.
notes: Seat prices are annual-billed monthly equivalents (monthly ~20% higher, not shown). 14-day trial, no card. Free plan for open-source projects. Security Scan is usage-priced. Code Generation mapped from CodeRabbit Agent; verify.

name: Qodo
short_description: AI code review and quality platform with agents for PR review and test generation.
notes: Pay-as-you-go credits pooled across team (packs 2,500-20,000). 14-day trial. Free for qualified OSS projects. Test Generation from general product knowledge; verify. Qodo has OSS repos (e.g. PR-Agent) not confirmed here.

name: Amp
short_description: Frontier coding agent running locally or in cloud 'orbs', triggered by CI failures, issues or schedules.
notes: Bring-your-own keys, no token fees. Megawatt includes 45,000 orb minutes. Gigawatt price not shown. Company attribution uncertain (Amp originated at Sourcegraph).

name: Junie
short_description: JetBrains' coding agent for IDEs, terminal and CI that plans and executes multi-step coding tasks.
notes: $8.33 is likely an annual-billed monthly equivalent. BYOK at provider rates, zero markup. CLI integrates with GitHub Actions and GitLab CI. Test Generation from general knowledge; verify.

name: Cline
short_description: Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code and CLI with bring-your-own-model and MCP marketplace.
notes: Pay only for inference (BYOK or Cline credits). Browser Automation from general product knowledge; verify.

name: Aider
short_description: Open-source terminal AI pair programmer that edits code, auto-commits to git and runs lint and tests.
notes: No pricing page; free tool, you pay your chosen LLM provider. Test Generation inferred from 'lint and test on every change' — verify.

name: OpenHands
short_description: Open-source, model-agnostic platform for cloud coding agents, with hosted and self-hosted options.
notes: Individual SaaS: BYOK or providers at cost, up to 10 daily conversations. all-hands.dev redirects to openhands.dev. Repo path may still be All-Hands-AI/OpenHands (redirects).
